claim_limits: Structures are decoded to the fixed facts recorded here (counts, sizes, bounds, digests); a decoded value is a reading of its layout, checked for internal consistency, not against game execution.
Textures: mip level 0 only; DXT1/DXT5/ARGB8888 are the only formats on the car files. Shader parameters other than textures are recorded by name hash; their meaning is not established.
Tuning: field names are not on the disc; fields are typed 32-bit words by offset, so their meaning (mass, torque, grip and so on) is unknown.
Shader binding (geometry shader index -> the car .xtp shader group) is a reading supported by the index range join over all cars, not by rendering in the game.
